The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] employed and retrofitted [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport]] '''''Resupply''''' to reload starfighters should they run out of warheads in battle. ''Resupply'' was present during the [[Capture of ZA-13|Capture]] and [[Defense of ZA-13|Defense]] of [[ZA-13]] where the plant was being returned to Imperial control against rogue [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin|Zaarin's]] [[Zaarin insurrection|insurrection]] and when the factory was supposed to be receiving upgrades and was attacked by a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] strike force during the process. The transport would then show up again at the [[Battle of RS-32|operation]] to capture [[RS-32]] to secure [[Mag-pulse warhead/Legends|Mag Pulse]] [[Warhead/Legends|warheads]].

==Behind the scenes==
''Resupply'' appears in [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']] at Battle 8 Combats 4, 5 and 6. When the player runs out of missiles, Resupply will appear to reload your craft. Interestingly enough, the transport can be destroyed in either Combats 4 and 5, but appears again in Combat 6. This article assumes that the transport survives all events.
